config.fills: Buy at ask, sell at bid, same labelled hourly bar; not guaranteed executable ticks.
config.long_rule: Choose closest strike to 70% of first Monday spot, among 60%-80% on $5 grid; ties lower strike. Entry quotes only.
config.short_rule: Monday 11 ET; lowest eligible $5 strike >= 103% spot among first three candidates; strike exceeds long strike.
config.exit_rule: Buy short back Friday 15 ET, or first 15 ET observation with ITM short and <= $0.05 mid extrinsic. No new call that week.
config.missing_exit: Halt at first unavailable mandatory exit. Never discard a filled trade using future liquidity.
config.dividends: AMZN has never paid cash dividends per Amazon IR FAQ; no dividends assumed in this sample.
config.selection_disclosure: Stock and parameters selected retrospectively for an educational case study, not an out-of-sample investment claim.
